_doc: Verified SDK facts (Agent A). "sdk" = line in sdk/cpp/cambc.h or imports.h; "runtime" = value read from the engine through the SDK by archive/agents/A/probe/a_sdk_dump.cpp in one official match (engine 1.0.3, cambc 3.0.5, map 00ambush, --release); raw records in archive/agents/A/evidence/sdk_probe_facts.jsonl. Values the SDK reads at runtime (settings, designs, items) could differ on another engine build: read the constants at runtime.

notes: ward_charges and the control-ward radii exist only in the raw settings record (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:44); cambc::constants does not expose them and the SDK has no control-ward placement API (only ordinary place_ward, sdk/cpp/cambc.h:3798; sdk/cpp/imports.h:204 control_ward_info is an ABI record without a wrapper).
tp_scroll_time is documented as retired/unused (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:51).
submit duration = max(minimum, base + ceil(gems * multiplier)) per the comments at sdk/cpp/cambc.h:98..sdk/cpp/cambc.h:104 (exact rounding beyond "rounded up" is not documented).

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:110 max_rounds: "Round limit before the game resolves its winner using tiebreakers"
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:113 winning_gems: "Submitted gems required for a team to win"
scoring_and_win.tiebreak: NOT documented in the SDK. Observed: 01boss-battle original vs original ended 0-0 at round 2000 with outcome teamB (tests/fixtures/teacher/reference_digests.json); the rule itself is unknown.

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:271 champion_draft (12 picks; cassi_and_issac is one pick)
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:3200 ability (slot 0/1, cooldown(), is_ready(), valid_tiles(), use())
notes: Every champion has exactly two ability slots (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:3487 std::array<ability,2>).
cooldown() = remaining owner turn-end ticks, 0 = ready (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:3268); max_cooldown is the configured value (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:2552).

ABI field max_charges is 0 for every ability (runtime); the public SDK exposes no charges, only the error code invalid_action_spell_cast_no_charges (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:361). Treat abilities as cooldown-only.
Focus scales spell effects: damage_amount() = Focus-scaled, includes caster bonuses (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:3385); dash landing damage = caster Focus * modifier (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:2624).

exclusive_with_movement: casting and normal movement are mutually exclusive in a round (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:2556); errors invalid_action_spell_cast_already_moved / invalid_action_move_exclusive_spell_cast (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:551, sdk/cpp/cambc.h:553).
One cast per turn: invalid_action_spell_cast_already_cast (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:357).
Cassi and Issac: one draft pick, two champions; if either dies both die (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:279, sdk/cpp/cambc.h:1431).

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:4486 camp_group.state() needs vision of a member spawn tile
notes: Rewards are per camp group: gold_value()/gem_value() (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:4480); a defeated group must be captured (capture_time rounds) before the reward; then it respawns (max_respawn_timer).
Camp attack range from design (wolf 3, elk 4, monolith 5, golem 4; clusters 3 but strength 0).

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:385 invalid_action_attack_already_attacked (one basic attack per turn unless an attack_reset ability restores it)
notes: Ranged basic attacks end movement in the original bot's experience (bot.cpp comments) - not documented in the SDK.
Altar locks are destroyed by basic attacks (altar_lock_hits = 5, sdk/cpp/cambc.h:153).

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:2626 ability_dash: range (diagonals count 1), radius, modifier, duration; legal dash path required
notes: move returns false (without spending the move) for a newly revealed hidden obstruction; known invalid destinations throw (doc above sdk/cpp/cambc.h:3826).
Blocked for move_towards: walls, holes, altars, enemy spawn region, visible units, teleport reservations (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:3846).
One move per turn: invalid_action_move_already_moved (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:375).
active_wards = 1: one live ward per champion (shared active placement limit, sdk/cpp/cambc.h:129).
ward_lifetime = -1: ordinary wards do not expire (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:144).
Allied ward already on the tile: invalid_action_place_ward_ally_ward_present (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:537).
Control wards: settings only; no API in this SDK.

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:1477 item_type (42 items: 7 families x 3 stats x shard/emblem)
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:1672 item_type queries (cost, combine_count, result, points, passive, is_purchasable)
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:3670 can_buy(item,count): shop allowed now, purchasable, gold >= cost*count
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:3684 can_buy(consumable): shop allowed, gold, count < carry_limit
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:401 invalid_action_buy_item_not_on_spawn: "Items can only be bought on spawn or while dead"
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:253 passive remote_shop (Tavi): buy equipment away from spawn and sell it on spawn
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:555/sdk/cpp/cambc.h:565 sell errors: not Tavi / not on spawn
notes: Shards cost 30 and are purchasable; emblems (cost 150) are not purchasable: five shards of one family/stat combine into the emblem (combine_count 5; summary event itemCombination).
Stat points are counts of the champion's growth (e.g. health 1 = one health_growth step), per the item comments "adds the champion's X growth" (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:1483).

Emblem passives (runtime magnitudes): monster +10% camp damage, durability -10% incoming damage, treasure +20% gold, jungle -30% camp damage taken, home recall 3 turn ends instead of 5; power/bruiser emblems have no passive (they count as extra stat shards).

Inventory limit for items: only the error invalid_action_buy_item_inventory_full exists (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:409); the size is not exposed by the SDK. stats_overflow error also exists (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:411).
item cost = full value, refunded in full when Tavi sells (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:1671).

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:1739 consumable_type tp_crystal / altar_lock, consumable_info{cost, carry_limit}
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:1749 raw ABI ids {0, 2} (raw id 1 = retired teleport scroll)

tp_crystal.doc: channel three turn ends, then flash to a reserved tile within range 3 (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:1770)

altar_lock.doc: placed on an altar within 2 tiles; blocks enemy tributes until destroyed by basic attacks (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:1772)

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:2745 stun prevents actions and interrupts channels
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:126 spawn_healing (fraction of max health per round on own spawn)
notes: Gem carriers lose gems on death (summary event gemLoss); the killer side may collect them (bot.cpp comments; pickup mechanics are not documented in the SDK).
Passive gold = 0 and assist gold = 0 at runtime: gold comes from camps and kills (kill_gold 100).
Marcella gains 2 gold per gem tributed; Prism gains 1.5 focus per carried gem (sdk/cpp/cambc.h:169, sdk/cpp/cambc.h:160).

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:5024 shared_memory_buffer: bounds-checked, reads/writes always reach the host
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:4009 draft_memory_buffer: snapshot captured at startup; assignment submits during the draft only; oversized input truncated, shorter input keeps the remaining bytes
notes: Shared memory is 8 bytes per team (whole team); the original uses all 64 bits (bot.h:21-28).
Draft memory is 1024 bytes, writable only during the draft, readable by champions (snapshot at guest start).
Each champion and the draft run as separate guests (probe: every champion guest printed its own records), so process memory is per champion; only shared/draft memory crosses guests.

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:4096 cambc::champions(team): all handles incl. out of vision
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:4486 camp group state needs a visible member tile
notes: Observable about enemies: identity/type/team and alive state for all; position, health, strength, focus, state flags, buffs, cooldowns (sdk_champion_cooldown is called on enemies by the original: bot.cpp:2874 (handle_enemies burst estimate)), carried gems and items only while visible; gold never.
Enemy submitted gems are global (global_submitted_gems).
Enemy wards, teleport reservations and altar locks are observable only when visible.

sdk: sdk/cpp/cambc.h:5191 fuel_remaining(): first draft turn 10x, each champion first turn 2x
sdk/cpp/cambc.h:5270 debug_block pauses fuel only in CAMBC_DEBUG builds; skipped in --release
notes: Measured: std::printf costs ~65 fuel per output character in this Wasm build (first probe: the 937,830-fuel first draft turn exhausted after ~14 KB of output). Any stdout logging must be budgeted.
Fuel exhaustion is reported as summary events fuelExhausted; team-<x>.fuel in the replay bundle is a per-turn fuel trace (used by tools/audit_equivalence.py).
